errors.aiChatReadOnly: The AI assistant is read-only: the “Allow changes by the AI assistant” permission is required. Contact an administrator.
errors.mcpReadOnly: MCP access is read-only — the “Allow MCP writes” permission is required to make changes. Contact an administrator.
errors.createForUsersForbidden: Insufficient permission to create tasks for these users
errors.updateNotAllowed: You are not allowed to modify this task
errors.deleteNotAllowed: You are not allowed to delete this task
errors.moveNotAllowed: You are not allowed to move this task
errors.assigneesOutOfScope: The requested assignees are outside your authorised scope
errors.moveOutOfScope: The requested move is outside your authorised scope
errors.copyTaskForbidden: Insufficient permission to copy this task

transport.disabled: MCP is disabled on this instance
transport.authMissing: Authentication required: connect the connector (OAuth) or provide an MCP key in the Authorization header.
transport.authInvalid: Authentication failed: invalid, expired or revoked token or MCP key, or disabled user account. Reconnect the connector.
transport.authQuery: The token in the URL (?token=) is no longer accepted: remove it from the address and send the MCP key in the “Authorization: Bearer …” header.
transport.permissionDenied: Permission denied: your account does not have the “Use the MCP connector” permission. Contact your administrator.
transport.sessionNotFound: Session not found or expired: reset the MCP connection

oauth.registerRateLimited: Too many registrations, try again later
oauth.tokenRateLimited: Too many requests, try again later
oauth.redirectUrisCount: redirect_uris must contain between 1 and 10 URIs
oauth.redirectUriRejected: Redirect URI rejected (HTTPS required, HTTP only on loopback, no fragment)
oauth.redirectUriMismatch: redirect_uri differs from the authorisation request
oauth.accountIneligible: Account disabled or without MCP permission
oauth.accountNotAllowed: This account is not allowed to use the MCP connector
